profile.headline: Software Engineer III at Jack Henry & Associates
profile.summary:
Full-stack Software Engineer with 25 years of experience seeking to further develop leadership and technical skills in a senior-level position.

Keywords:
Java, Javascript, Groovy, C#, Spring Framework, .NET, MS SQL Server, Postgres, H2, JUnit, Cypress, Cucumber, JSP, Eclipse RCP, Maven, Tomcat, Jenkins, Linux, Windows, Google Cloud, Agile

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Lead developer for the BSA and SAR Center products produced by the Financial Crimes Division. Contributing developer for the Fraud Detective product as needed. 

BSA: A Java thick-client application that assists banks in complying with the Banking Secrecy Act (BSA). Comprises a Eclipse Rich Client Platform (RCP) user interface and a dedicated server component for multi-user operation. The client and server are coupled through a Microsoft SQL Server database.

Fraud Detective: A Java thick-client application that assists banks in detecting and preventing fraud by analyzing transaction records for suspicious patterns. Comprises an RCP user interface and a dedicated server component for multi-user operation. The client and server are coupled through a Microsoft SQL Server database.

SAR Center: A pure web application that assists banks in filling out Suspicious Activity Reports for submission to the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN). Leverages the Spring Framework and is able to operate in multi-tenant Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) environments as well as standalone deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · Eclipse RCP · Git · Maven · Tomcat · Microsoft SQL Server · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Commercial website development with ASP.NET MVC and JQuery
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · C# · Microsoft SQL Server · jQuery

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and maintained key service components in the MCS (Management Control System) system management application for Verari's FOREST containerized computing solution. MCS was a web service developed in Java that featured a service-oriented architecture in which individual backend services were presented to the user as a unified whole by an orchestrator. Was responsible in particular for the SNMP client service that managed Common Control Modules within the container and the service that allowed for secure KVM access to server blades.

* Developed support in the MCS application for management of power supply components of Verari's BladeRack 2 XE product. Used the Apache Commons Net  Java component to implement a multi-threaded telnet client to communicate with the power supply controllers.

* Developed a solution in Java to allow for redundant failover of the Verari Command Center (VCC) system management application from one server to a backup in case of failure. VCC was a Java web service that used Apache Axis and ran on Apache Tomcat. 

* Developed support in the VCC application for management of virtual machines hosted on blades running VMware ESX. Used the VMware SOAP web service API to retrieve information about available virtual machines and allow power operations on them within VCC.

* Developed and maintained Windows installers for components of the VCC application that supported the Windows environment.

* Developed and maintained the core database module for the VCC application. Used JDBC to create a data-access object to manipulate data stored in a PostgreSQL database. Also made modifications to the JAXB schema that defined the data objects within the system.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer/Test Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed and applied a systematic release test procedure for release of the MPI/Pro high-performance distributed computing middleware product. The task included building, release testing, packaging, and archiving of the software for different combinations of operating system, hardware architecture, and interconnect network.

* Provided customer-facing email and phone support for MPI/Pro.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: Developed and applied a systematic release test procedure for the company’s high-performance distributed computing middleware product and automated that testing with scripts written in Perl and BASH. Built, tested, packaged, and archived the software for different combinations of operating system, hardware architecture, and interconnect network. Assisted the sales team in answering customer questions regarding software compatibility, capabilities, and usage. Provided customer-facing email and telephone support for the software in consultation with the principal Software Engineer. Planned and implemented migration of the company’s support request tracking system onto a separate server from the company’s main web server and implemented spam filtering to cut down on the number of false support tickets created from emails.

positions.title: Systems Analyst II
positions.description:
* Lead developer in charge of the ISTARS (International Statistical Tracking and Reporting System) revenue assurance application. ISTARS was a CGI application written in C that interfaced with an Oracle database using the Pro*C tools.

* Redesigned and implemented ISTARS web functionality deemed critical by end users.

* Played a central role in an initiative to streamline and audit the mediation process of a front-line product in order to make it auditable by the ISTARS application.

* Member of the development team responsible for maintaining the INMP (International Network Mediation Processor) call billing mediation application. INMP was a batch-processing application written in C++.
positions.insights: Skills: C (Programming Language) · C++ · Oracle SQL Developer
